Because the story is an extremely brief snippet of dialogue ("flash fiction" in script format) relying entirely on vague subtext, neither of the two main characters is developed into a truly "complex character." While there are hints of a shared past and lingering resentment (such as the renovated stairs and someone moving away), the reader is given no concrete information about their backstories, specific motivations, strengths, or weaknesses.
